additional_info.subject: RE: ID0382238-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001721] Both outlets unavailable CRM:00797001290
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-DE Team,
The customer reports that both charging points are unavailable and cannot be used. They suspect that the SIM card may be the issue again.
Upon checking the logs, we found that the charger has been offline on SCB since 2024-09-18T07:53 UTC. Due to the absence of an SCB connection, our ability to provide remote support is currently limited. To proceed, it would be ideal to have someone on-site to check the following:
Ensure that the router is connected to the internet.
Verify that the charger is powered on.
Additionally, please consider the following potential reasons for the charger being offline:
Internet Issues:
There may be an issue with the Siemens router, possibly due to the WAN switching from Cellular to Ethernet because of a failover function.
I recommend initiating a local reboot to restore functionality or performing a hard reset via OCPP (if the charger is connected to an OCPP server).
Mobile Network Issues:
The data service from the mobile network operator might be unavailable.
The SIM card could be disabled or expired. Please clean and reinsert the SIM card into the XF3 and XF4 routers to ensure proper connectivity.
The monthly data volume may have been exhausted.
Signal strength could be weakened due to changes in radio transmission conditions.
For M2M contracts, the IP might not be enabled.
Teltonika Router Issues:
The router might have switched to an incorrect network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
The router may have experienced hardware failure.
There could be a software crash in the router.
We recommend carrying spare routers when visiting the site, so you can replace them if needed.
